name: badge
title: Badge
description: Compact labels for status, counts, and metadata.

api.description: Compact label for status and metadata. Label ink is optically centered to cap height with text-box when available, and a 1cap line box otherwise. Inline badges also use vertical-align middle so they sit on the text line next to copy. Use leading and trailing slots for any node before or after the label. Use gap to control space between slots and the label. Compose a nested counter or OptionList dropdown via count, children, and render.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style of the badge.

props.name: size
props.description: T-shirt height and type size. Nested counter chips are supported on md, lg, and xl only.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius of the badge.

props.name: cornerShape
props.description: Instance corner curve. Omit to inherit --df-corner-shape from the theme (set at create/init).

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between leading, label, trailing, and count. Design-scale units from the shared spacing scale (none/0, even integers through 200, half-steps such as 0.5 and 1.5). One unit = 0.25rem via --spacing-unit. Omit to use the size default: 0.5 on xs and sm, 1 on md and lg, 1.5 on xl.

props.name: leading
props.description: Slot before the label. Pass any node. Prefer StatusDot for online and live presence marks. SVG glyphs inherit the badge size step.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Slot after the label. Pass any node (close button, chevron, or custom control). Prefer this over placing trailing nodes in children.

props.name: count
props.description: Trailing count chip bound to any numeric value (1 to 4+ digits). Shown on md, lg, and xl hosts. Renders after the trailing slot.

props.name: render
props.description: Host element to clone badge styles onto. For dropdowns, prefer OptionListTrigger render={<Badge />}.

props.name: children
props.description: Label content between the leading and trailing slots. Prefer leading and trailing for icons and controls.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional styles on the badge.

groups.title: Composition
groups.description: Patterns built with leading, trailing, count, children, or render. Leading icon (leading): Pass any node to leading for a mark before the label. Prefer StatusDot for a filled presence mark that follows the badge size. SVG children inherit the badge glyph size for the size step. Close button (trailing): Pass a button with an X icon to trailing. The button inherits badge color and is keyboard focusable. Counter (count | children): Prefer the count prop for numeric data. Or nest a second Badge. Host size must be md, lg, or xl so the chip stays readable. Width grows with 1 to 4+ digits.

groups.title: Dropdown panel
groups.description: Pass these on OptionListContent when the badge opens an option list. Placement is relative to the badge trigger. alignOffset (number): Extra shift along the alignment axis in pixels. sideOffset (number): Gap between the badge and the menu. alignItemWithTrigger (boolean): When true, menu width matches the badge. When false, the menu sizes to its option content.

groups.title: Tokens
groups.description: Theme defaults live on :root. Override these globally or on a local host.

props.name: --df-badge-gap
props.description: Resolved unitless spacing-scale multiplier for space between leading, label, trailing, and count. Set by the gap prop, or from the size default tokens when gap is omitted.

props.name: --df-badge-gap-xs
props.description: Default gap step for size xs.

props.name: --df-badge-gap-sm
props.description: Default gap step for size sm.

props.name: --df-badge-gap-md
props.description: Default gap step for size md.

props.name: --df-badge-gap-lg
props.description: Default gap step for size lg.

props.name: --df-badge-gap-xl
props.description: Default gap step for size xl.

props.name: --spacing-unit
props.description: Base unit multiplied by --df-badge-gap to resolve the flex gap.

props.name: --primary
props.description: Default variant fill.

props.name: --df-badge-secondary-bg
props.description: Secondary variant fill. One step stronger than accent and muted surfaces.

props.name: --df-badge-secondary-fg
props.description: Secondary variant label.

props.name: --destructive
props.description: Destructive variant fill.

props.name: --df-badge-outline-border
props.description: Outline variant border.

props.name: --muted
props.description: Ghost variant hover fill.

props.name: --muted-foreground
props.description: Ghost variant label.

props.name: --radius-4xl
props.description: Default radius step. The radius prop can select any --radius-* step, from none to full.

props.name: --df-corner-shape
props.description: Theme corner curve for all kit chrome. round = circular arcs; smooth = continuous squircle. Set with df-ui init --corner-shape, or override on :root. Default round.

props.name: --df-label-line-height
props.description: Line box for label flex centering. Defaults to --df-leading-none. When text-box is unavailable and the cap unit is supported, the kit sets this to 1cap so flex centering matches cap-height ink.
